description: The acoustic and electric guitars are each secured in separate holders on the double guitar stand, with the black cap hanging from the electric guitar’s headstock.
The green air freshener is installed in the automatic dispenser, and the white air freshener and green cap are inside the green tote bag.

The diffuser stick is in the diffuser bottle, the orange cube from the white container is in the blue calendar case beside the other cube, and the diffuser leaf is on top of the brown powder in the white container.
The brown sandals and green shoes are on the top rack of the shoe rack, and the backpack is no longer on top of the rack.
Banknote and card in the wallet's visible bill and card compartments, with the coin in the small bowl.
The dirty clothes are inside the laundry bag, the bolster is below the pillow, and the the gray pillow are stacked on top of the green pillow.
The eye drops is in the blue pouch, then the e-reader and blue pouch that contains the eyedrop are put inside the black bag, and that black bag is finally closed.
Single-tower miniature placed on top of the blue book, with the twin-tower miniature placed on top of the yellow book.

The turquoise container, black bottle, and gray water bottle are all upright on the table and closed with their matching lids: the turquoise lid on the turquoise container, the black-and-white lid on the black bottle, and the small gray cap on the gray water bottle.
Place the blue bottle on the right side of the pot, with the cap attached to it like a hanger, and tidy up the pebbles by placing them where they belong inside the pot.
The medal is inside the closed green box, and the green box is inside the closed yellow box,
The tofu is put back from plate to the tofu plate, and the rice plate has one spoonful of chicken popcorn and two broccoli florets beside the rice.
Butter box closed with its white cover, metal spoon placed inside the glass, and blue cup covered with its metal cover.
Fire-lit candle, with the lighter and key stored inside the jeans pocket and the jeans positioned to the left of the candle.
The AirPods and Apple Watch are each connected to their suitable visible charging devices.
The water bottle and clock are inside the closed container.
Some coffee beans transferred from inside transparent jar into inside orange jar, with no beans spilled outside either jar.

Remove the fork and spoon from the plate, close the coffee container with its lid, and place both the closed coffee container and the bottle on the cleared serving surface of the upright plate. The plate must remain right side up, with no utensils underneath it.
The game controller is connected to the charger block by the orange cable, and the charger block is plugged into the white outlet.
Closed aqua green container with all items placed on top and arranged from largest to smallest, from left to right.
Cup containing one tablespoon of cooking oil.
The unwrapped chocolate bar is cut into two halves, both then placed inside the closed yellow container
Cutlery from inside the container is placed in the outside compartments with matching cutlery, with the container lid closed.
Rolled-up desk mat to the left of the tablet, with the book on top of the tablet.
Dish and spoon clean and dry on the counter, with the drying towel beside them.
Both Joy-Cons are attached to the Nintendo Switch, the console is placed in the Switch dock, and the game card is inserted with the game card slot cover closed.
Doll placed on top of the motorcycle helmet and covered by the black cap, with the key placed on top of the black cap and covered by the white cap.
The closed shoe box containing the yellow-black shoe is placed on the blue chair, with the red shoe on top of the box
Egg and candy placed inside the bowl, with the bowl stored inside the closed air fryer and the black electrical plug connected to the white outlet.
Egg stored inside the closed container beside the sauces, with the sauce bottles and pepper bottle standing upright.
Move one of the egg from the left hand side clear egg tray to the right hand side black egg tray following the rest of the pattern of the placement of the eggs.
The whiteboard is erased, and the red marker is inside the eraser on the whiteboard shelf.
The earphones are unplugged from the laptop, and the closed e-reader case and mouse are placed side by side on top of the keyboard.
The closed eye drops, bandage, and chapstick are inside the blue bag.
All makeup items properly closed, with the palette stored inside the white pouch, and all items neatly stored inside the large black pouch on the left.
Toy cars inside the closed green box, with the AC remote and bowl on top of the box and the cat figurine on top of the bowl.
Put the final move of the game to win as either side
Supplement bottle whose bottle body is white inside the container, with all other items remaining outside the container.
Handcuffs and stethoscope stored inside the tote bag, with the tote bag placed inside the closed top drawer of the desktop storage and the belt positioned on top of the storage.
All wooden hangers grouped together on the left side of the pole and all black hangers grouped together on the right side, with the middle section left empty.
Black, white, and green hats placed on the hooks from left to right in that order, with the rightmost hook empty.
Cable-connected headphones hanging on the headphone stand, with the other headphones placed on top of the cleared yellow notebook.
Closed pink ice cream jug stored on the upper section of the right fridge door, with the milk stored on the lower section of the fridge door.
Kendama ball properly attached to the standing kendama stick that was originally laid down, with the yellow can stacked on top of the other can.
Lanyard and toy car inside the jar, with the detached key from the lanyard inside the trash can.
CTRL keycap attached to the keyboard where the eraser was, with the closed black earphone case to the right of the keyboard and the eraser on top of the case.
Laptop lid open, with the key and pen placed together on the left side of the laptop.
The laptop is opened and connected to power, with the mouse to its right and the headphones in front of its keyboard side.
The lava toast is placed on the plate with the chocolate on top, and both are inside the microwave.
Detached spiral light bulb stored inside the closed red trash can, with the glasses still placed on top of the trash can.
A vertical line drawn with a marker in the middle of the paper, with the pen and capped/closed marker on the left side of the line and the calculator on the right side of it.
The empty cup filled with instant coffee and water, with the mixture stirred using the spoon.
The cotton is moved from its pack to be inside the clear container, and the closed cyan lipstick is inside the pouch.
All well-closed visible cosmetic items are inside the red container.
The white bowl is empty, the mango and banana are on the yellow plate under the blue cover, and the yellow mug is covered with its metal lid.
The marker, pen, and highlighter are each stored in their own suitable boxes that correspond with each item.
The four matryoshka dolls are nested inside one another.
The batteries are inside the closed matryoshka doll; the battery cover is attached to the AC remote; and the doll is on top of the remote.
The blue notebook is closed, the glasses are placed on top of the keyboard, and the AirPods are off the keyboard.
Move all of the orange juice from a plastic bottle to a reusable bottle by first emptying the reusable bottle that is filled with water into the sink.
The water fully poured half to the metal pot and half to the yellow mug, and the yellow mug is covered with its metal lid.
All fully closed spray and closed toiletries are inside the pink pouch.
Spice jar closed with its yellow lid and moved to be standing next to the cocoa canister, with the tea sachet inside the teal mug and the ginger tea box positioned to the left of the mug.
Blank loose-leaf paper attached to the ring binder, with the scissors inside the closed red book resting on top of the closed ring binder.
The blue book is on top of the red folder with the well-closed yellow scissors and closed perfume bottle on that blue book. The other item is placed on the wooden surface.
The trash bin is on the upright position filled with plastic bag containing the black food container and the empty toothpaste.
The cup contains some milk from the sealed milk box.
The SD card and battery are installed inside the camera, and the camera battery compartment is closed.
Tennis racket inside the front backpack compartment, with the tie and cap inside the main compartment.
Sandals neatly stored inside the closed shoe bag, with the racket placed on top of the orange table.
The radio is inside the closed box.
The marker is inside the red stationery case, the white AC remote is inside the standing remote holder, and the green notebook is on the laptop stand.

Gray LAN cable plugged into the black laptop, with the orange cable disconnected from the JBL speaker and laptop and connected instead to the black charger block. The closed laptop, router, JBL speaker, and charger block are stacked from bottom to top in that order.
A royal flush is arranged on the cardboard from lowest to highest left to right, with the remaining cards on the table.

Dumbbell and water bottle stored inside the brown paper bag, with the filled paper bag placed inside the laundry basket, and the rugby ball positioned on the empty spot previously occupied by the paper bag.
White tube, orange bottle, dark bottle, and their loose caps stored inside the closed pink pouch.
Chili sauce on the plate, with the fork and spoon on the plate, the closed chili sauce bottle on the table, and the knife covered with a tissue on the table.

Store the green-wrapped teabags, yellow-wrapped teabags, and bare teabags in their respective separate storage locations: green packets in the green-packet compartment, yellow packets in the yellow-packet compartment, and bare teabags in the yellow box. Each location must contain only its respective type, with no other types mixed in. Leave the red packets outside these groups and close the yellow box.
All of appliances are inside the closed green container, with the orange glove placed on top of the closed container.
Sandals stored inside the closed orange box, with the shoes stored inside the closed brown-and-white box.
Blue socks placed inside the blue shoes and grey socks placed inside the black sandals, with the blue shoes positioned to the right of the black sandals
The blue soap liquid and brown soap liquid are mixed together with the white bottle cap being its mixture place.
AirPod case placed in front of the socks, with the socks folded together and stored inside the bucket.
The blocks are stacked from bottom to top in this order: yellow, green, red, blue.
The closed book is stacked on top of the closed laptop.
Stack the book on top of the paper and the pen on top of the book
All paper cups from both bottles are nested together in a single upright stack on the table, with their openings facing upward.
Visible kitchen items are stacked into big to small configuration from bottom to top, with the knife and fork inside the bowl.
The round yellow paper is stapled to the white A4 paper with the fully inserted stapler with its staples filling.
All bottles or container properly closed then all items stored inside the black plastic bag.
The short lens is attached to the camera and the camera is inside the camera bag, while the detached long lens is covered with the dust cap and wrapped in the lens cloth.
Tablet cleaned using screen cleaner spray and a microfiber cloth, with the microfiber cloth and closed cleaner bottle placed on top of the tablet.
The tape is inside the tape dispenser, and the stapler and marker are inside the pencil holder.
Each tea bag is inside the cup with the matching color.
Each marker is fitted with its matching color cap.
Only one of the visible colored cups contains some water, the water in that cup is stirred, and there is no visible spill outside the cups.
Put shoes on the floor into the shoes rack. Each shoes has to be placed to correct pair indicated by the same color for left and right shoe.
The condiments are placed on the scale for weighing.
All items outside their containers, with all containers then being closed with their matching cover.
All personal care product containers properly closed with their matching cap and all of them stand straight instead of laid down.
Place the orange towel on the metal toilet tissue holder, and position the broom beside the standing wiper.

The closed shampoo bottle and soap are in the right compartment of the grey container, and the toothbrush and toothpaste are secured under the elastic strap in the left compartment; the container is closed.
The blue moisturizer and green toner are mixed together on the table using a cotton bud.
Closed toothpaste and folded toothbrush stored inside the closed travel case.
Toothbrush and toothpaste inside the white basket, with the trimmer closed and placed beside the metal basket
Toothpaste applied to the toothbrush, with the toothbrush rinsed and the toothpaste tube closed.
The toy motorcycle and fan are inside the closed container.
stand the golden trophy up to the right side of the silver trophy then put the racket on top of the piano table and put the luggage and blue bag to the floor right side of the black piano chair
Prepare a closed and latched clear lunchbox containing the wrapped snack and capped bottle (at first cap separated).
The flour in the container is mixed with all the water from one full measuring cup.
